uwp_capture_status: partial: UWP app launched (uwp-app-runner ok:true, pid 10540, windowTitle 'Bluetooth Advertisement C# Sample'), but the legacy UWP CoreWindow's UIA tree is opaque to winapp (inspect/search return 0 interior elements) and synthetic mouse/keyboard input could not switch the ListBox scenarios. Only Scenario 1 (initial view) was captured as a genuine golden; Scenarios 2-4 golden screenshots were not obtainable. Behavioral verdicts for Scenarios 3-4 are based on the WinUI capture plus UWP source analysis.

features.name: Scenario 1 - Foreground watcher
features.description: Foreground BLE advertisement watcher. Two checkboxes (1M+Coded PHYs, coexistence/performance optimizations), Run/Stop buttons, a received-advertisement ListBox, and a status area. Run starts a BluetoothLEAdvertisementWatcher; Stop stops it. Status updates on each action.
expected_behaviour: Run button starts the watcher and updates the status text (e.g. 'Watcher started.')
Stop button stops the watcher and updates the status text
Both checkboxes are present (disabled/annotated when the feature is unsupported by the adapter)

features.name: Scenario 2 - Foreground publisher
features.description: Foreground BLE advertisement publisher. One checkbox (2M+Coded PHYs), Run/Stop buttons, published-payload text, and a status area. Run starts a BluetoothLEAdvertisementPublisher and reports its status; Stop stops it.
expected_behaviour: Run button starts the publisher and updates status (started + published payload; on a radio-less machine reports an aborted/RadioNotAvailable status)
Stop button stops the publisher and updates status

features.name: Scenario 3 - Background watcher
features.description: Background BLE advertisement watcher using a BackgroundTaskBuilder + BluetoothLEAdvertisementWatcherTrigger. Two checkboxes, Run/Stop buttons, received-advertisement ListBox, and status. Run requests background access and registers the background task, then reports a status ('Background watcher registered.' / 'Cannot register background task...' / 'Background tasks may be disabled...'). Stop unregisters and reports status.
expected_behaviour: Run button registers the background task and updates the status text with a success or explicit error message (UWP source always NotifyUser's one of the three outcomes)
Stop button unregisters the task and updates status
Both checkboxes and the received-advertisement list are present

features.name: Scenario 4 - Background publisher
features.description: Background BLE advertisement publisher using a BackgroundTaskBuilder + BluetoothLEAdvertisementPublisherTrigger. One checkbox, Run/Stop buttons, published-payload text, and status. Run requests background access and registers the publisher task, reporting a status. Stop unregisters and reports status.
expected_behaviour: Run button registers the background publisher task and updates the status text with a success or explicit error message
Stop button unregisters the task and updates status
